Will Democrats vote to impeach President Donald Trump for a third time? It’s unclear if there’s an appetite. 81964.subject: Democrats Win Congress as CLARITY Runs Out of Time
81964.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Democrats**](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/democrats-win-senate-control-as-clarity-act-remains-stalled)[ won Congress as CLARITY stays stuck](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/democrats-win-senate-control-as-clarity-act-remains-stalled)

* [**Polygon**](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/polygon-proposal-seeks-hard-fork-to-recover-70-49-million-pol)[ may fork to return 70M stolen POL](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/polygon-proposal-seeks-hard-fork-to-recover-70-49-million-pol)

* [**Binance**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-expands-proof-of-reserves-to-44-tokens-after-hack)[ widened its reserve proof to 44 tokens](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-expands-proof-of-reserves-to-44-tokens-after-hack)

* [**Morgan Stanley**](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/morgan-stanley-tokenizes-us-stocks-and-treasuries-through-dtcc)[ tokenized stocks through DTCC](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/morgan-stanley-tokenizes-us-stocks-and-treasuries-through-dtcc)

* [**Circle's network**](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/circle-payments-network-reaches-41-3-billion-annualized-volume-in-q3)[ hit $41.3B annualized volume](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/circle-payments-network-reaches-41-3-billion-annualized-volume-in-q3)

Bitcoin fell to about $75,600 as results came in on Tuesday night, then [reclaimed $79,000](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-reclaims-79-000-after-5-rebound-from-election-night-low) within 12 hours as Democrats secured both chambers of Congress. Ether and Solana recovered by similar amounts. Tokens linked to the Trump family did not. World Liberty Financial's [WLFI fell 11.3%](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/wlfi-slides-11-on-election-night-lags-bitcoin-s-recovery) and was still 5.1% lower at 5 a.m. ET, and TRUMP ended the night about 6.6% lower.

The Associated Press called the [Senate](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/democrats-win-senate-control-as-clarity-act-remains-stalled) late Tuesday and the [House](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/democrats-win-house-gaining-new-leverage-over-crypto-legislation) early today. The CLARITY Act, crypto's market-structure bill, is still stuck on the Senate floor. On Sept. 15, a vote to start debate [failed 49 to 50](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/senate-blocks-clarity-act-49-50-with-no-democratic-votes-to-proceed), with no Democrat voting yes. If the bill does not pass before this Congress ends on Jan. 3, it starts over. Ending debate takes 60 votes under either party's majority. By our count, CLARITY needs 11 more yes votes than it got in September.

Much of crypto policy now runs without Congress. The stablecoin law, GENIUS, takes effect on Jan. 18, 2027, under a rule the OCC [finalized in October](https://thedefiant.io/converge/regulation/occ-finalizes-genius-act-rule-drops-third-party-yield-presump

81963.body:

Автор: GenAI Works

Welcome back! Stanford retested 50 famous AI failures and found most of them dead, one model performed brain surgery on another, and Revolut cut its AI bill by 10x by walking away from a hosted model.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Half of AI’s famous flaws have already died: 50 findings retested across 20 models, and the only one that got worse is the one that flatters you. Somebody edited an AI’s brain like a config file: 0.016% of the weights changed, and a math score went from 7.9% to 48.1% with no training run. Two kinds of software, and AI only does one well: One test tells you which kind you’re building, and it decides whether an agent saves you a month or costs you one. What a token actually costs: Two cents a conversation, $6,000 a month at scale, and three ways people are getting out from under it. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Half of AI’s famous flaws already died Two years ago, pointing out that AI couldn’t count the R’s in “strawberry” got a laugh. People still repeat it. Stanford took 50 of the most-cited findings about what AI gets wrong and ran every one of them again, this time against 20 models released over the past two years. Almost half are gone. The strawberry one. Losing a fact buried in the middle of a long document. Gone. Made-up sources were the big one for a while. When ChatGPT first arrived, more than half the references an early model handed you were invented.  In the retest, the newest models from OpenAI and Anthropic made up close to none. Some models still do. Flaws also do not last as long as people assume. Half of the ones with a clear end date disappeared within 15 months. One went the other way. AI still leans toward agreeing with you, and it has gotten worse. Tell it what you like and it praises your work harder to match. All 50 are browsable. Pick a flaw and watch it fade across models, or pick a model and see what it still has. Our take: The lesson is about dates, not models. Any claim about what AI can’t do needs a timestamp, because most of them were tested on something two years old.  The one flaw that survives is the one that flatters you, so when you want an honest read on your own idea, ask the model to argue against it before you ask what it thinks. 81932.subject: AVALANCHE OCTOBER 2026 RECAP
81932.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-october-2026-recap

October was the month Summit’s momentum turned into policy and capital. South Korea’s Financial Services Commission moved from exploring tokenization to publishing rules for it, institutions from Hyundai to Charles Schwab kept naming Avalanche directly, and Team1 Japan became Team1’s 10th global chapter.
Avalanche also launched Avalanche Originals, a new series taking viewers behind the scenes with the builders Summit introduced.
Here’s everything that happened in October.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Avalanche Leads All Chains in Tokenized Stock Growth:
Avalanche added more tokenized stock market cap than any other chain in September, up $245.5 million and led by Securitize. [Stock Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/6cad1406-48b9-4a5c-9e93-231ebe85392a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Tokenized Treasuries Are Up 4x This Year:
Tokenized U.S. Treasuries on Avalanche climbed 14% in Q3 alone to $545 million, now four times where they started the year. [Treasuries [ https://substack.com/redirect/c05f9abb-8008-421c-b446-cd9992fd355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Pharaoh Exchange Hits a Record Month:
Avalanche’s top DEX posted all-time high monthly volume and fees, coming right off announcing 24/7 permissionless stock trading. [Pharaoh [ https://substack.com/redirect/268cd9e9-907b-4258-aefc-d46af180ca1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Japan Becomes the 10th Global Chapter:
Team1 Japan officially launched after 30 events across four cities, 1,200 attendees, 18 Avalanche Gourmet Nights, and four institutional events, with the Foundation welcoming the milestone as proof of Japan’s growing institutional adoption.
Team1 Chapters Build Across the Globe:
Team1 chapters remained active globally this month. Türkiye held UniTour #3 across three cities and six universities before hosting its first hackathon with OKX Türkiye, attracting 60+ developers and 30 projects. Vietnam reached 250+ students through its VKU Uni Tour, hosted a She Build meetup and opened registration for a 420-builder UniHack. Africa held workshops in Zaria and Warri, Nigeria, and an Avalanche Academy session in Johannesburg. Thailand hosted its first Kasetsart University session, while first-ever meetups took place in Lviv and Shenzhen.
In the U.S., Team1 held a Blockchain x AI event during SF Tech Week and launched its weekly Team1 Break X Spaces. India partnered with India Blockchain Week ahead of its November 2 Mumbai Networking Gala, while Brazil announced a trading card meetup with YourGrails and NYC hosted a rooftop meetup with The Grotto.
